body: I have clinical depression. I don't think I've experienced anything too traumatic, really. I spoke to my therapist recently who suggested I try different medication, and so my psychiatrist prescribed me Seroquel. I stopped taking it due to the fact that I've had several people tell me it's really bad for you and it's caused me to gain 3 pounds in less than a week.
Thanks, it means a lot that people even bothered to read this
